name: What should I tell a kitchen designer so the new storage works in real life?

mainEntity.name: What should I tell a kitchen designer so the new storage works in real life?

acceptedAnswer.text: A remodel should be planned around storage needs even if the new cabinets look attractive, because appearance alone does not guarantee usable capacity. Elite Remodeling & Design can connect cabinet layout, finishes, countertops, appliances, and storage details during design development. Context: Problems often return when homeowners choose standard cabinet arrangements without considering bulky cookware, small appliances, food containers, or accessibility. Key factors: inventory; task zones; drawer versus door bases; shelf heights; future needs. Practical guidance: Create a cabinet-by-cabinet assignment before selections are finalized. Verify that each item has a practical home and that doors, drawers, and appliances can open together. Use 3D visualization to review the overall balance before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Share your item inventory, cooking habits, appliance dimensions, reach needs, and the storage problems you experience now. Assign purposes to cabinets before final selections and test drawer, door, and appliance clearances together.
